page_title: RAY 1-2 BAR | Rayo Vallecano v Barcelona 27/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's it for today, Cesar Soto Grado has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+11' Raphinha (Barcelona) commits a foul and Cesar Soto Grado immediately signals a free kick.
90+11' A dangerous looking corner kick from Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared to safety by the defence.
90+10' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The referee signals a corner kick to Rayo Vallecano.
90+10' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+9' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
90+9' A cross from a corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+7' Marc Bernal (Barcelona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+6' Substitution. Pau Victor (Barcelona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lamine Yamal walks off.
90+5' Raphinha (Barcelona) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90+4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marc Bernal (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

90+3' Marc Bernal (Barcelona) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the bottom right corner. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Dani Cardenas and his brilliant save.

90+2' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Raphinha (Barcelona) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
90+2' Poor challenge! Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for tripping and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle.
90+1' Hansi Flick is forced to make a change. Pedri (Barcelona) is unable to continue due to injury, Fermin Lopez comes on.
90' 10 additional min. will be played.
89' Pedri (Barcelona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
88' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Raphinha (Barcelona).
87' Cesar Soto Grado couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) and blew his whistle.
85' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
82' 1 - 2 Goal! Lamine Yamal shows great vision to find Dani Olmo (Barcelona) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 1:2.

81' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Cesar Soto Grado with no other option than to blow for a foul. Barcelona are awarded the free kick.
81' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) jumps highest to win the header from the corner, but his close-range attempt is well blocked by a defender.
81' Raphinha (Barcelona) will deliver the corner kick.
80' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
80' Raphinha (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

80' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

79' This was a piece of cake for Marc-Andre ter Stegen. Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
74' Celebrations are cut short for Barcelona as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
72' Wait! Referee Cesar Soto Grado has indicated he is going to review the Barcelona goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
71' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
71' Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:2.
70' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Rayo Vallecano was in an offside position.
69' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) launches a cross from the corner, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen is alert to thwart the effort.
68' Inigo Perez is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Oscar Valentin suffers an injury and Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
66' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) replaces Gerard Martin.
64' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Jorge de Frutos.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) will replace Sergio Camello.
63' The total number of attempts is 4:14. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:3.
60' 1 - 1 Goal! Raphinha provides Pedri (Barcelona) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 1:1.

58' Crossbar! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
58' The players claim that Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
56' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Garcia will be replaced by Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano).
56' It will be a substitution. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to enter the pitch as Unai Lopez walks off.

55' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
54' Raphinha (Barcelona) shoots from the free kick, but his good effort flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
52' Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game. One of the players from Rayo Vallecano won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Barcelona.
51' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
50' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
49' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
47' Raphinha (Barcelona) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
46' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
46' Half-time substitution. Ferran Torres is replaced by Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
46' The whistle blows and Cesar Soto Grado starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
45+1' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
43' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Marc-Andre ter Stegen.
40' The game is interrupted. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
39' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to find Jules Kounde, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
37' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Dani Cardenas thwarts him with a nice save.
36' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
35' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Barcelona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
31' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
30' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities. The ratio of the ball possession is 42:58.
27' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for a foul. Cesar Soto Grado had a clear view and blows his whistle.
26' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

23' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
22' The linesman signals that Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
21' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

19' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Dani Cardenas is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
19' Raphinha (Barcelona) works the corner short.
19' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
17' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
15' The game is interrupted now, Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
15' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle after Marc Bernal (Barcelona) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
14' PENALTY APPEAL after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
13' Barcelona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.

9' 1 - 0 Goal! Jorge de Frutos plays in Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders. He shoots from inside the box into the right side of the net! Great finish - 1:0.

8' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.

7' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Marc-Andre ter Stegen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
7' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
7' Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
7' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
5' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen intercepts the ball.
4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is adjudged offside.
2' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after dangerous play.
2' Neat passing move from Barcelona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
